summary_1line: Bhishma recounts how Samvara gained supremacy by revering Brahmanas and their teachings, illustrating the power of spiritual authority and proper recipients of gifts.

image_candidates.scene_text: Indra disguised as an ash-smeared ascetic with matted hair arrives in a crude chariot before the Asura king Samvara.
Samvara bows at the feet of learned Brahmanas while they sit teaching scriptures, likened to bees filling a honeycomb with nectar.
Soma explains to a listening king that Brahmanas wield speech as their weapon while warriors wield arms.
